title: mdBook page
description: The YAML front matter of a Markdown page. The Slipway preprocessor strips it before mdBook renders the page, so it never shows as text. The first # heading names the page when title is absent.

description.description: One sentence about the page, for search results and link previews.

title.description: The page's title, shown in the sidebar and the browser tab. Use the same words as the first heading.
